page0.text:
I feel bad for Issei, but I should probably prioritize my part-time job.
I never promised I would go, but since I said I'd try, I should probably keep my word.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page0:1

page1.text:
"Sorry Issei. I have plans already, so can I get a raincheck on this morning's tasks?"
"Plans? Oh you mean your part-time job. Yeah, sorry for troubling you. A couple of days won't make any difference, so go ahead and head to your other commitment."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page1:1

page2.text:
"Thanks. I'll get back to those tasks first thing in the morning, so please let me off the hook this time."
"Hm? I thought I said this wasn't a serious issue. We got the urgent stuff done this morning. You can finish up the rest whenever you're free, Emiya."
"If you say so. Is it okay if I pick up where I left off whenever I don't have work?"
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page2:1

page3.text:
"Certainly. I'll be counting on you when that time comes, Emiya."
Issei bids me a stiff farewell and leaves the classroom.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page3:1

page4.text:
"...Okay, then."
I shouldn't dawdle.
I may not have been given a specific time, but now that I've decided to go to my part-time job, I need to hurry over to the neighboring town.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page4:1

page5.text:
"Geez. I thought I was going to help out just a little, but they gave me 30,000 yen."
It's like an unexpected windfall, or a stroke of good luck.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page5:1

page6.text:
Copenhagen, where I worked today, is like a bar and supermarket that sells liquor all in one, and it takes a lot of people to restock inventory for this place.
It's a job that needs at least five people, but the more people you have after that makes everyone's lives easier.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page6:1

page7.text:
Yet, the boss is always like,
"Anyone who can help can just swing by!"
He mentioned it so casually to the part-time workers and seemed to think it was enough.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page7:1

page8.text: But I'm the only one who showed up. The only people there for inventory were me, the boss, and Neko, his daughter. All hell broke loose.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page8:1

page9.text:
"You dummy! Of course nobody would come!"
Neko was scolding the boss, yet I was the only fool who came, ready to be sacrificed.
The two of them unenthusiastically applauded when I showed up, and then we all decided to organize the storage room as much as possible.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page9:1

page10.text:
And then...
...we somehow finished the inventory in two hours.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page10:1

page11.text:
"This was amazing. Going for the extra brownie points or something, Shirou?"
The boss remarks as he eats a brown cake and surveys the afternoon's work.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page11:1

page12.text: "Not exactly. I'm just used to manual labor, and I've been working here long enough that I know where most things go in the storage room. I haven't been working here since I was young for nothing, you know!"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page12:1

page13.text:
"Oh yeah. How long has it been already, Shirou? Five years?"
"Something like that. You were one of the only places that hired me soon after my old man died."
"That so? No wonder I feel old."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page13:1

page14.text:
The boss stuffs his mouth with rum cake.
Next to him, Neko is nursing a bottle of warm sake.
The owner has a sweet tooth, while the daughter is the drinker of the family. They sure balance each other out well.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page14:1

page15.text:
And...
"But honestly you really helped us out. I'd feel bad if all you got from your hard work was just a few slices of cake. So...here's a little something from me."
He waves three 10,000 yen bills at me.
It's more than I'd get for a week's worth of labor, not three hours.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page15:1

page16.text:
"Oh. Thanks."
I hesitate, but I take whatever I can get.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page16:1

page17.text:
Just as I'm about to leave Copenhagen...
"Mmm, hold up. Emiyan, who did you hear about today's job from?"
Neko stops me while she is curled up in front of a heater, resting.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page17:1

page18.text:
"Um, I think it was Furumi."
"(Sigh) That idiot should know better than to push his own work onto a student. Well, whatever. So you're saying you came to help stock inventory even though you only heard about it secondhand?"
"Uh...well, I was told to help if I wasn't busy."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page18:1

page19.text:
"Furumi's a dumbass, but you're no better you know.
Whatever. I bet you're the kind of person who can never say no. I know; I remember that one time when you watched the store when Dad and I both got sick."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page19:1

page20.text: "Huh? That's not true. I won't do things for people when I know I can't. I only do things I know I'm able to."
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page20:1

page21.text:
"That right, huh? I seem to recall you were sick that day, too.
Whatever. Anyway, my point is that you're a good guy, but kinda dumb, which leaves me a little worried about you, so tell Fujimura to swing by soon 'cuz I got a beef with her."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page21:1

page22.text:
Neko makes circles with her fingers in the air as she downs her sake.
She seems to think I'm a dragonfly or something.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page22:1

page23.text:
"Okay... Um, so just tell Fuji-nee that?"
"Yup. See ya. Try not to push yourself too hard, boy."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-05:page23:1
